data.name: Mental Acuity
data.description: Your explorations into the secret mysteries of the world have granted you a preternatural understanding of all things and you just keep getting smarter. You gain a +1 inherent bonus to Intelligence upon taking this revelation and another at every third oracle level gained thereafter. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.
